_transcription: ENGLISH half only, CBSE Class 10 Science (086), set 31/4/2 (Series D4CBA/4), sibling of the opener 31/4/1. plan.txt gave no skip list (no numbered cells), so shared questions were matched by CONTENT against data/2024-31-4-1.questions.json, each confirmed on this paper's own page, and the reference's stem/context/options/answer/chapter/subtopic/difficulty reused byte for byte. 27 page images, idx 0-26 (cover announces 27 printed pages; last folio 27 on idx 26). idx 0 cover, idx 1 Hindi instructions, idx 2 English instructions + Q1-2; English on EVERY EVEN index 2-26, each odd index the Hindi of the page after it; odd-page tops checked on the contact sheet and at full size where load-bearing, all Hindi, and every English page ends on a complete question or on a question continued on the next EVEN page (Q29 picture on idx 14, its parts on idx 16; Q35(a) table on idx 18, its parts on idx 20). Numbering runs 1-39 unbroken. Instructions (i)-(vii) confirm sci80. Instruction (viii) prints NO count of internal choices, so the roster was built by walking the marking scheme (ms idx 2-7) for a bare OR: after Q21, 23, 33, 34, 35, 36, 37(c), 38(c), 39(c) = 9 alternatives, each confirmed against a printed OR on the paper. Q32 prints parts (a) and (b) with no OR (one row). The 8-page scheme is for 31/4/2 alone (cover 'Q.P. CODE 31/4/2', footer 'X SCIENCE 31/4/2 PAGE n' on every page read), answering Q1-Q39. All 20 Section-A answers are CBSE's own, read off the scheme page image (ms idx 2); each re-derived, 19 agree; Q19 (the same question as 31/4/1 Q17) disagrees (flagged, CBSE's B kept). No void note on any MCQ; one award-regardless note on Q38(b) (the same note as 31/4/1 Q37(b)). Decimal points on this paper are RAISED dots (Q35 table 37·5), written {\cdot}. 54 rows (20 MCQ, 34 subjective): 43 copied from 31/4/1, 11 transcribed fresh (Q1, Q18, Q22, Q24, Q25, Q26, Q27, Q30, Q32, Q34a, Q34b).
